sn36.16:1.1: Atha kho āyasmā Ānando yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || pe || || 3 Ekam antaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantam Ānandam Bhagavā etad avoca || ||
sn36.16:1.2: Katamā nu kho vedanā || katamo vedanānirodho || katamā vedanānirodhagāminī paṭipadā ||
sn36.16:1.3: ko vedanāya assādo || ko ādinavo || kim nissaraṇan ti || 4
sn36.16:1.4: Bhagavaṃmūlakā no bhante dhammā Bhagavannettikā Bhagavaṃpaṭisaraṇā || sādhu bhante Bhagavantaññeva paṭibhātu etassa bhāsitassa attho || Bhagavato sutvā bhikkhū dhāressantīti || ||
sn36.16:1.5: Tena hi Ānanda suṇohi sādhukam manasi karohi bhāsissāmīti || ||
sn36.16:1.6: Evam bhante ti kho āyasmā Ānando paccassosi || || 5-8
sn36.16:1.9: sukhā vedanā dukkhā vedanā adukkhamasukhā vedanā ||
sn36.16:1.12: khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno rāgo paṭippassaddho hoti || doso paṭippassaddho hoti || moho paṭippassaddho hotīti || || 2
